response:
**Verdict:** Keep Exp501. It is a quadratic second view, not a head tweak. It is **not** MultiRocket (that is \(\Delta x\) plus extra pooling). Do not claim a gain. The only plausible path to ~10% relative **macro** TPR is lifting the scale family (~0.65) without cutting the other three.

## Distinct from MultiRocket
MiniRocket PPV is linear conv then a bias. MultiRocket’s extra channel is a **linear high-pass**. Here the second series is \(z((x^{\odot 2}))\) with \(x\) already row-z, so PPV sees **even / instantaneous-energy geometry**. Sign is dropped; AM and block variance are not. Overlap with raw PPV and with \(\Delta x\) exists (local \(\times3\) also inflates \(|\Delta x|\)), but the feature map is not the same.

## Failure and leak risks
1. **Second z-score wipes kurtosis.** After row-z, \(\mathrm{mean}(x^2)\approx 1\) for every row. \(\mathrm{std}(x^2)\) is a 4th-moment scale. \(z(x^2)\) keeps only **where** energy sits and deletes **how peaked** it is. A 20% scale/level bump inflates \(\mathrm{std}(x^2)\) and flattens the rest — the same self-masking row-z already applies to spikes.
2. **Joint OAS, \(p=8064\), \(n\le 1000\).** Concat **before** RobustScaler/OAS doubles dimension and dependence. Shrinkage rises; raw shape features can be diluted. If joint loses to \(\max(\text{raw OAS}, \text{square-only})\) on the screen min, that is covariance, not a failed energy hypothesis. Do not add test-chosen fusion weights.
3. **Redundancy.** Many kernels already move PPV when local amplitude changes. Energy helps when oscillations **average through** a linear kernel but not through \(k*x^2\). If square-only ≈ raw on **scale**, stop.
4. **Degenerate energy rows.** Constants → 0 (specified). Near-constant \(|x|\), short \(n\), or low excess kurtosis → near-zero view, collapsed RobustScaler IQRs, dummy PPV.
5. **Protocol leaks to avoid:** one MiniRocket fit on pooled views; different reference IDs per view; OAS/scaler on anything but fold fit-normal; score-space mixing; opening TEST on a failed gate; any window/kernel/fusion chosen on held-normal TPR.
6. **Tail risk.** Skewed energy PPV can fatten 3NN scores. The \(\le 3\times\) baseline tail rule is the correct kill switch at this FPR (max held-normal).
7. **Screen vs goal.** Gate is \(+0.02\) on min and non-worse mean — much weaker than 10% relative macro vs the **fixed MiniRocket baseline**. Energy is aimed at scale; quarter/phase may be flat or down (DTW already showed that trade).

## Fixed protocol (frozen)
Per fold, fit-normal only:
- View A: existing row-z \(x\) (baseline MiniRocket, seed `20260721`, 4096→4032). **Do not refit this for the baseline candidate.**
- View B: \(e = z(x^{\odot 2})\) with the **same** z-function/ddof as row-z; std 0 → 0. Second MiniRocket, **same seed**, biases from fit-normal **energy** rows only.
- Same cap-1000 reference **IDs** for all heads.
- Candidates, in order: (i) frozen baseline nearest-3 local-gap; (ii) raw OAS+mean-3NN; (iii) square-only OAS+mean-3NN; (iv) concat \( [ \phi_A(x); \phi_B(e) ] \) → RobustScaler 10–90 (fit-normal) → **same** residual-preserving OAS → mean-3NN. No extra weights. Threshold = max held-normal score. Corruptions and post-perturbation row-z unchanged.
- Gate: min of four family-mean recalls \(\ge\) best of (i–ii) \(+0.02\), mean not lower, tail rule, then full 1117. Else do not open TEST.

## Mandatory checks
- Energy-row collapse rate; fraction of B-dims with train IQR ~ 0.
- Per-family deltas vs raw OAS, **scale first**; quarter must not replay the DTW regression.
- Joint vs square-only vs raw on **min** (OAS-dilution test).
- Tail ratio; identical whitening codepath on 4032 and 8064.
- Fold isolation, seed/bias split, shared reference IDs.

If square-only is dead on scale, do **not** swap in \(\Delta x\). One fallback, still parameter-light: MiniRocket on row-z **moving RMS** with a **frozen** window \(\max(8,\lfloor n/10\rfloor)\), never tuned on this screen. Otherwise do not widen scope.
